title: Personal power: Páez and the networks of loyalty
goal: Read how a caudillo governed through personal ties, and use verbs with a fixed preposition to describe those ties.

items: Use verbs with a fixed preposition (*contar con*, *depender de*, *confiar en*) to describe a caudillo's network.
Say how a caudillo governed differently from a modern official.
Say who José Antonio Páez was and what he gave to local chiefs.
Say why a network of loyalties was fragile.
Use the key words of this lesson: official, llanero, fragile, president and local.
